mutants.description: MUTANT m01: roe divides net income by year-end equity while leverage uses average equity.
MUTANT m02: ROIC rejects a zero tax rate (strict lower bound), though the contract allows 0 <= tax_rate.
MUTANT m03: Piotroski asset turnover (signal 9) divides revenue by year-end total assets, not the previous year's.
MUTANT m04: ROIC raises only on exactly zero average invested capital; negative capital is divided through.
MUTANT m05: Piotroski signal 2 tests net income instead of cash flow from operations.
MUTANT m06: ROIC divides NOPAT by year-end invested capital, not by the average of the two year ends.
MUTANT m07: accruals_cash_flow scales by year-end total assets, although the contract scales by average total assets.
MUTANT m08: Piotroski signal 3 scales last year's net income by last year's assets, not by the assets two years back.
MUTANT m09: Beneish TATA divides by average total assets, not by year-end total assets as the contract states.
MUTANT m10: standardize keeps the earliest filed annual observation, so the original 10-K wins over a later restatement.
MUTANT m11: ROIC returns 0.0 for non-positive average invested capital instead of raising ValueError, a guard that hides an undefined ratio.
MUTANT m12: balance-sheet accruals add the change in current liabilities instead of subtracting it (a sign error).
MUTANT m13: Piotroski gross-margin signal uses a weak inequality (>=), so an unchanged margin scores one point.
MUTANT m14: modified Jones divides the intercept and PP&E regressors by lagged assets but leaves the revenue-less-receivables regressor unscaled.
MUTANT m15: days_sales_outstanding returns receivables over revenue as a fraction of a year, without the 365-day factor.
MUTANT m16: _previous picks the earliest period end in the 350-380 day window instead of the latest.
MUTANT n01: ROIC grosses operating income up by the tax rate, (1 + tax_rate), instead of taxing it, (1 - tax_rate).
MUTANT n02: days_sales_outstanding uses a 360-day year, a common bank-convention student error, not 365.
MUTANT n03: gross_margin divides gross profit by cost of goods sold instead of by revenue (a mark-up, not a margin).
MUTANT p01: previous year is the latest earlier period end, without the 350 to 380 day window.
MUTANT p02: a flow item counts as annual only for a duration of 360 to 370 days (window narrowed).
MUTANT p03: a ratio whose result overflows to infinity is returned instead of raising ValueError.
MUTANT p04: Piotroski CFO_t is scaled by year-end total assets instead of beginning-of-year assets.
MUTANT p05: the as-of cut-off is exclusive: a filing made on the as-of date is not yet known.
MUTANT p06: an observation without a val is taken as zero instead of raising ValueError.
MUTANT p07: a missing previous-year total assets or equity is filled from the current year in DuPont.
p08: the rank test only rejects an all-zero regressor column; a linearly dependent design (two regressors proportional to each other) is not rejected and the fit is returned.
p09: Piotroski signal 1 tests ROA >= 0 (weak) instead of ROA > 0 (strict), so a zero ROA scores 1.
p10: the tag priority is read backwards: the last tag in the list that has a value supplies the item.
p11: modified_jones adds a constant column (an intercept) to the regression and returns only the three slope coefficients, so the fitted and discretionary parts are the intercept model's.
p12: accruals_balance_sheet subtracts the depreciation with the wrong sign (adds it back).
p13: the as-of selection orders candidates by filing date only and keeps the first listed on a tie, so a 10-K/A filed on the same day as the original (larger accn) does not supersede it.
p14: standardize reads the observations of every unit of a tag, not only USD for money and shares for share counts.
p15: standardize reads obs['accn'] by direct indexing, so an annual observation without an accession number raises KeyError.
p16: the as-of tie-break orders (filed, form, accn), so on one filing date the form string decides and not the accession number.
p17: modified_jones requires five firm-years, one more than the four the contract states, so a four-row sample is rejected.
p18: modified_jones checks the finiteness of total accruals and lagged assets only, so NaN or infinite revenue or receivables changes pass.
p19: accruals_cash_flow divides by average total assets with plain division, so a zero average raises ZeroDivisionError.
p20: piotroski_f_score divides net income by the previous year's assets with plain division, so zero previous-year assets raises ZeroDivisionError.
p21: piotroski_f_score reads the period's shares_outstanding by direct indexing, so a missing share count raises KeyError.
p22: standardize reads shares_outstanding in unit USD, so no share count is ever standardized.
p23: DuPont leverage divides average assets by year-end equity while roe still uses average equity.
p24: accruals_balance_sheet scales by year-end total assets instead of average total assets.
p25: Piotroski signal 4 compares CFO scaled by year-end total assets with ROA scaled by beginning-of-year assets.
p26: ROIC invested capital adds cash instead of subtracting it.
p27: modified_jones returns the residual lists sorted by lagged assets instead of in sample order.
p28: Beneish DEPI divides by PP&E alone instead of depreciation plus PP&E.
p29: beneish_m_score reads the period's current liabilities by direct indexing, so a missing item raises KeyError.
p30: on one filing date the plain 10-K beats a 10-K/A whatever the accession numbers say.
p31: Piotroski signal 5 uses a weak inequality (leverage not higher), so an exact tie scores 1.
p32: Piotroski signal 7 uses a strict inequality, so unchanged share counts (no issuance) score 0.
p33: Piotroski leverage (signal 5) uses total liabilities instead of long-term debt.
p34: Piotroski signal 6 uses current assets over total assets as the current ratio.
p35: accruals_cash_flow raises ZeroDivisionError, not ValueError, when the average total assets is zero.
p36: accruals_balance_sheet divides by average total assets with plain division, so a zero average raises ZeroDivisionError.
p37: two annual observations that tie on filing date with no accession number and different values are not reported as a conflict.
